title: Arc gallery
description: Botanical plates travel around a circular rail, with a single specimen held upright at its apex.
useCase: Browse a small collection with a continuous draggable arc and a legible selected item.
interaction: Drag the plates or use the previous and next controls.

assets.description: Untitled (Fern Study), c. 1850, from the Hatton Fern Album
Plum Garden at Kameido (Kameido Umeyashiki), from the series "One Hundred Famous Views of Edo (Meisho Edo hyakkei)"

reducedMotion: Navigation changes the selected plate immediately, without spring interpolation.
limitations: Five repeated plates wrap around one circular rail; this is not a free-position canvas.
look: Off-white page with five white-matted botanical prints fanned along a downward-curving arc, a small letterspaced header and an italic serif caption between arrows.
motion: Dragging or arrow buttons rotate the cards around a circular rail, tilting and fading them with distance; release snaps to the nearest card, nudged by flick velocity, on a spring.
adapt: Card placement is computed in `paint` (arc spacing `0.49` rad per card, tilt `angle * 25`) and the spring in `tick` (stiffness `155`, damping `21`); `choose` sets the target index. Replace the `cards` image and title pairs.
